EmailTemplate.description: Information on conditional admission to Arizona State University
EmailTemplate.name: INTL Conditional Admission Steps
EmailTemplate.subject: Conditional admission to Arizona State University
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for contacting Admission Services at Arizona State University. You will be offered conditional admission if you meet all of the academic requirements but do not meet the English language proficiency requirement. Below are the steps to apply to ASU.
Review our admission requirements and application procedures at https://students.asu.edu/international/future/undergrad%20.
Please note that some ASU colleges and schools have higher standards for admission into their programs. See major specific admission requirements on Degree Search at https://webapp4.asu.edu/programs/t5/?init=false&nopassive=true%20https://webapp4.asu.edu/programs/t5/?init=false&nopassive=true.
Complete the application and submit the nonrefundable application fee of $85 (USD) online. Application fees cannot be waived or transferred to a future application.
Mail official transcripts or certified copies of your last three years of high school to Admission Services, as well as any university course work you have completed. If the date of your graduation is not clearly listed on your transcripts, please enclose a copy of your graduation diploma.
Mail official transcripts to: Undergraduate Admission Services Arizona State University 1151 S. Forest Ave. Tempe, AZ 85287-0112
If you have any questions or need assistance, please feel free to contact me.
Sincerely,
{!User.Recruiter_Full_Name__c} {!User.Recruiter_Title__c} Admission Services {!User.Recruiter_Email__c} {!User.Recruiter_Phone__c}
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
{!Case.Thread_Id}
